    key = (f["origin"], f["destination"])
    if key not in routes:
        routes[key] = []
    routes[key].append(dict(f))

# Find all possible one-stop (2-segment) connections
# A one-stop itinerary = flight1 (A->B) + flight2 (B->C) where arrival of flight1 < departure of flight2
print("\\n=== ONE-STOP CONNECTING ITINERARIES ===")
connections = []
for f1 in flights:
    for f2 in flights:
        if f1["destination"] == f2["origin"] and f1["origin"] != f2["destination"]:
            # Check timing: f1 arrives before f2 departs (with some connection time)
            arr1 = f1["arrival_time"]
            dep2 = f2["departure_time"]
            if arr1 < dep2:  # Simple string comparison works for HH:MM format
                p1 = json.loads(f1["cabin_prices_json"])
                p2 = json.loads(f2["cabin_prices_json"])
                eco1 = p1.get("economy", p1.get("basic_economy", 0))
                eco2 = p2.get("economy", p2.get("basic_economy", 0))
                total = eco1 + eco2
                conn_info = {
                    "leg1_id": f1["flight_id"],
                    "leg1_route": f"{f1['origin']}->{f1['destination']}",
                    "leg1_dep": f1["departure_time"],

                    "leg2_arr": f2["arrival_time"],
                    "leg2_eco": eco2,
                    "total_route": f"{f1['origin']}->{f1['destination']}->{f2['destination']}",
                    "total_eco_price": total
                }
                connections.append(conn_info)
                
print(f"Found {len(connections)} one-stop connections")
for c in connections:
    print(f"  {c['total_route']}: {c['leg1_id']}({c['leg1_dep']}-{c['leg1_arr']}) + {c['leg2_id']}({c['leg2_dep']}-{c['leg2_arr']}) = ${c['total_eco_price']}")
